_comment: Template for running against a real CRM. Copy to settings.json (gitignored) and fill in. Install the database extras first: pip install -e .[db]
_db: Password is never stored here. Set the named environment variable instead.
_ssh: Used to tunnel to the database. The host key must already be in your known_hosts; unknown keys are rejected.
_source_mappings: Ties a workbook filename to a source. file_markers are matched case-insensitively as substrings of the filename.
_thresholds: Score bands. A pair must clear auto_accept_score AND beat the runner-up by min_score_gap to be auto-accepted; ambiguous pairs fall to review instead.
